summary: v3 re-test after SecurityConfig CORS + JwtAuthenticationEntryPoint fixes. Both critical blockers from iteration_2 are RESOLVED. Backend pytest: 20/20 passed via PUBLIC URL with Origin header. Frontend: login → /chat → send message → realtime WS all WORK end-to-end. Curl confirms: public POST /api/auth/login with Origin header returns 200 (was 403); wrong creds return 401 JSON (was 403 empty); /api/auth/me without token returns 401 JSON (was 403 empty); wss://parlance-dev.preview.emergentagent.com/api/ws?token=... upgrades successfully and delivers realtime message frames (7 frames captured on single message send).

minor.issue: Returns 401 'Unauthorized' instead of 409 Conflict when registering an already-existing email. AuthService likely throws a generic auth exception that the JwtAuthenticationEntryPoint catches and maps to 401. Should throw ResponseStatusException(CONFLICT) or a distinct duplicate-email exception. Frontend can still surface an error but the status code is semantically wrong.
Returns 401 instead of 409 on duplicate channel name — same root cause as register duplicate.
Still uses request.getRemoteAddr() (proxy IP behind ingress) — not a new issue, carried over from iter_2 code review. Unverified if it actually blocks on ingress proxy IP but worth confirming.

ui_bugs.issue: Display Name input and Save button lack data-testid (profile-display-name-input, profile-save-button) — selectors had to fall back to name/text matching; tests are fragile.
Logout icon/button next to admin profile (bottom-left of sidebar) has no data-testid='logout-button'. Visible in screenshot but not reachable by stable selector.

action_items: (Minor) Return 409 Conflict on duplicate email/register and duplicate channel name — currently returns 401 because the JwtAuthenticationEntryPoint swallows the generic auth exception. Wrap duplicate checks to throw ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT, 'Email already exists') explicitly from AuthService/ChannelService.
(Minor) Add data-testid='profile-display-name-input', data-testid='profile-save-button', data-testid='logout-button' (on chat sidebar profile area) for stable playwright testing.
(Carry-over) Verify brute-force key: request.getRemoteAddr() behind Emergent ingress is the proxy IP. Use X-Forwarded-For with a trust list, or use email alone as key.
(Cleanup) test_parlance.py::test_send_message_to_channel has a return statement that pytest warns about — remove the return.
critical_code_review_comments: CORS + 401 entry-point fixes look correct and are verified end-to-end. Good call on setAllowedOriginPatterns for Spring 6 + allowCredentials=true.

JwtAuthenticationEntryPoint maps too broadly: any auth-related exception thrown inside a controller now gets 401'd, even legitimate 4xx business errors (duplicate email, duplicate channel). Tighten exception flow so ResponseStatusException with explicit status bypasses the entry point.
WebSocketConfig.setAllowedOrigins('*') still inconsistent with strict CORS list — works but document rationale or align.

Pytest still runs without BASE_URL env var exposed — testing agents must export REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL before running. Consider adding a conftest.py that loads /app/frontend/.env as fallback so tests work out-of-the-box.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All critical v3 blockers (CORS + 401 propagation + WebSocket) are FIXED and re-verified. Backend is production-ready from a security/auth perspective. Only residual items are minor: (1) duplicate-email returns 401 instead of 409, (2) a few missing data-testids on Settings/Logout. To run pytest: `export REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://parlance-dev.preview.emergentagent.com && python -m pytest /app/backend/tests/test_parlance.py -v`. WebSocket test uses ws://localhost:8001 internally but wss:// via public URL is ALSO confirmed working via browser (captured 7 frames on message send).
rca_of_issue: Iteration 2 RCA was correct. Fix applied in SecurityConfig.java (setAllowedOriginPatterns + explicit JwtAuthenticationEntryPoint returning 401 JSON) resolved both issues. Verification: curl -i -X POST https://parlance-dev.preview.emergentagent.com/api/auth/login -H 'Origin: https://parlance-dev.preview.emergentagent.com' -d '{...}' -> 200 OK; wrong creds -> 401 {detail: Unauthorized}; /api/auth/me without token -> 401 {detail: Unauthorized}.
